name: Sorbet
tagline: Candy colours, plum ink, one spring.

idea_headline: A sheet of stickers, peeled onto the page.
idea: Sorbet is pop: five candy colours on cream, every shape die-cut with a plum outline, a white rim and a hard drop, like stickers on a lunchbox. Headlines are chunky, corners are fat, and exactly one thing springs when you touch it. The colours do the shouting, so the words never have to.
use_for: Consumer apps and launches, kids and food subjects, events and celebrations, playful counters, pickers and polls, anything that should feel like a good day.
avoid_when: Serious, institutional or grieving subjects, dense data, long reading, or any page where candy would read as not listening.
principles_headline: Five candies, plum ink, one spring.
principles: A shape gets a 3px plum outline, a white rim and a hard drop. Flat things without an outline are ground, not content.
Ink is deep plum. It keeps the candies from going garish and the page from going corporate.
Strawberry leads; blueberry, mango, lime and grape follow. They are the chart series and the sticker colours. Status borrows lime, mango and strawberry.
20px on cards and stickers, full pills on buttons, tags and fields. Nothing has a sharp corner.
A pressed thing dips and springs back once with an overshoot. One hero element may float. Nothing else moves on its own.
voice: Say what things cost and what they include: "Tickets are free; the churros are not."
Bad news is cheerful and honest: "Churros are gone for today."
One exclamation mark per page, and it lives on a sticker.
colour_note: Day is cream white with the candies at full saturation and plum ink. Night is the parlour after close: deep plum walls, cream-pink ink, the candies unchanged so stickers glow. Status text is darkened on cream so lime, mango and strawberry words stay readable; on night the candies serve as text directly.
chart_note: The five candies in order. Rounded bar ends, no gridlines heavier than the soft rule, direct labels where they fit.
type_headline: Fredoka shouts, Nunito chats, DM Mono counts tickets.
type_note: Fredoka at 600 and 700 for headlines, titles, labels, sticker words and numerals. Nunito for body. DM Mono for ticket numbers and timestamps.
space_headline: Fat corners, a 3px outline, a 7px drop.
space: Between stickers so drops never touch.
The scoop diameter in a stack; sticker dots are 16px.
edges: Every sticker and control. The rule that makes it a sticker.
A halo outside the outline: the die-cut edge. Box-shadow spread, no blur.
Section dividers are a wavy SVG rule, 8px amplitude, 40px wavelength.
depth: A hard 7px offset in ink under every sticker and button. No blur.
translateY(4px) and the drop shrinks to 3px; then the spring back.
motion: One easing for everything: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), 160ms. Hover scales 1.03; press dips 4px; both overshoot once.
One hero sticker may use the kit animate-float. Never more than one.
Stickers reveal with reveal-scale, staggered 100ms, like being peeled on.
Bars grow from the baseline with the spring, 300ms.
No confetti, no spinners, no infinite loops besides the one float.
components_headline: Stickers, pills, scoops and a speech bubble.
components_note: Kit components take Sorbet through the contract: cream grounds, strawberry primary, 20px radius, soft rules. Authored classes add the outline, the rim, the drop and the spring: sb-sticker on a card, sb-btn on a button.

buttons_note: Kit buttons left; authored sb-btn right: pills with the outline, rim and drop. The primary is strawberry, mango is for the one new thing. Press for the spring.

tags_note: Tags are candy pills with an ink outline. The sticker chip is rotated 6° with the rim and drop: one per view, for the newest thing.
fields_note: Fields are cream pills with the 3px outline; focus is a blueberry outline. Labels are Fredoka caps.

callouts_note: Callouts are speech bubbles: a sticker with a tail, a bold lead word, one sentence. Lime for yes, mango for almost, strawberry for no.
chart_comp_note: Charts are the candies in order with rounded bar ends. For counts under ten, prefer a scoop stack to a bar.
table_note: Tables are the stall list: Fredoka names, DM Mono counts, soft rules, a candy tag in the last column.

card_note: A card is a sticker: outline, rim, drop, and one chip peeled onto its corner. Titles are Fredoka; facts are Nunito.

hand.headline: Fat outlines, flat candy, a hard drop.
hand.note: Sorbet draws like a sticker sheet: every shape gets a 3px plum outline with round caps, flat candy fills, a hard 6px drop, and nothing else. No gradients, no texture, no thin lines. Whatever the artifact is about, draw it as a sticker.
rules: 3px ink, round caps and joins, on every shape.
Flat candy: strawberry first, blueberry second; lilac for quiet parts.
A hard 6px drop in ink under the main body. No blur.
Big stickers get a 3px white rim outside the outline. Small ones do not.
Fredoka bold for the one number; DM Mono caps for labels.
A drawing may float (one per page) or spring on hover; it never fades in.

motifs_note: Sorbet draws with the sticker sheet. The data lives in the stickers: a count is a stack of scoops, a share is a row of candy dots, the new thing wears the chip.

sample:
ScoopWeekend market · Sat 03 Oct
This weekend!

dos: Outline, rim, drop: every content shape is a sticker.
Plum ink, never black; candies at full saturation.
Pills for controls, 20px for cards, waves for dividers.
One spring per touch; one floating hero; one rotated chip per view.
donts: No black text, no grey grounds, no thin lines.
No gradients, no blur, no confetti.
No more than one exclamation mark per page.
No candy as body text on cream; status words use the darkened variants.
binding_losses: The sticker outline, rim and drop, the spring easing, the wave, the speech bubble tail and the scoop stack have no contract slot; they are sb-* classes, the --ds-sticker and --ds-spring properties and inline SVG. Lilac rides the accent slot so kit components get the quiet fill.
footer: Cream first, night parlour second. Fonts: Fredoka 500/600/700, Nunito 400/600/700 and italic, DM Mono 400/500, all Google-hosted.

tpl.ed_deck: Churro Bros sold 310 in two hours and then stood there smiling. What one small queue says about the whole market.
tpl.ed_byline: By the market crew · 3 Oct 2026 · 4 min read
tpl.ed_body: By eleven the queue for churros ran past the craft tent, and by noon the sign went up. Nobody minded. The waffles two stalls down had their best day, the band drew a crowd that had nowhere else to be, and the gate count kept climbing until six. One sold-out stall turned out to be the market working as intended.
steps: Each sticker is one visitor; the colour is the stall they head for first.
Food fills first, then music. Craft stays steady all day. The unit grid shows the split without a legend.
